blind.description: An ornate wooden round accent table consisting of a circular tabletop with a scalloped, beaded raised rim, supported by a central turned pedestal column resting on four curved, decorative cabriole legs. The entire model has a polished reddish-brown wood finish. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or fused distortions.
blind.from_above: A circular brown tabletop with a textured wood grain center and a scalloped, decorative pie-crust rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.3 feet tall (roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet in diameter.

notes: model features four cabriole legs instead of three
